# tenzir_ingest_endpoint (Resource)

An ingest endpoint: a URL that turns every request sent to it with its token into one event, for pipelines on the deployments of the organization that may read it. Destroying it drops the events it buffers.

Needs `Organization.createIngestEndpoint` and `IngestEndpoint.read`, `IngestEndpoint.readToken`, `IngestEndpoint.update` and `IngestEndpoint.delete`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "tenzir_ingest_endpoint" "webhooks" {
  organization_id = data.tenzir_organization.acme.id
  name            = "webhooks"
  description     = "Alerts from the ticketing system"
  readable_by = {
    workspaces = [tenzir_workspace.soc.id]
  }
}

output "webhook_url" {
  value = tenzir_ingest_endpoint.webhooks.url
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name pipelines refer to the endpoint by: 3 to 21 lowercase letters, digits and single dashes. Changing it replaces the endpoint.
- `organization_id` (String) The ID or slug of the organization.

### Optional

- `description` (String) What the endpoint receives.
- `readable_by` (Attributes) Restricts which deployments may read the endpoint. Without it, every deployment that the owner reaches may read; with it, only those listed, and none when both lists are empty. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--readable_by))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The endpoint ID.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) The token senders authenticate with.
- `url` (String) Where senders post events, at any path. Null when the platform has no host for ingest endpoints.

<a id="nestedatt--readable_by"></a>
### Nested Schema for `readable_by`

Optional:

- `deployments` (Set of String) IDs of deployments that may read.
- `workspaces` (Set of String) IDs of workspaces whose deployments, including future ones, may read.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The endpoint ID.
terraform import tenzir_ingest_endpoint.webhooks 01a1a206-0623-7ac3-b6c8-7cbce7b57de2
```
